items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: And he taught me how to play the euphonium and any of the instruments like the trumpet, the French horn and the bass

ctx.x: Ah, yes. He a, he went to the First World War, when he came back, he settled in Chicago. And he worked for the telephone company there as a cabinet maker. And then he taught music on the side. And he used to have different orchestras and bands, not jazz bands, concert bands, that

he took charge of. And our house was always a -- in Blue Island -- was always a scene of rehearsals for the local kids that went to the high school. And Baco would tutor them and teach 'em. And he taught me how to play the euphonium and any of the instruments like the trumpet, the French horn and the bass, anything that had three valves I would play. He taught me all that including piano. My aunt, who was German, taught me piano. And , once I had drums, I had drum lessons from my uncle too.
So he was an all around musician, then.
